item.title: Solved: How to Hide Passwords in a Python Script Securely
item.description:
How to Hide Passwords in a Python Script Securely

When developing Python applications that require an ODBC connection, it is necessary to handle usernames and passwords securely. If you find yourself wondering how to obscure sensitive information like passwords in your scripts, there are several methods you can employ. Below, I will outline various approaches, including practical examples and alternative techniques.

Method 1: Compiled Module Obfuscation

One simple method to obscure passwords is to create a separate Python module that contains the sensitive information.

item.title: Solved: How to Securely Store Secret Keys and Passwords in Version Control Systems
item.description:
How to Securely Store Secret Keys and Passwords in Version Control Systems

Managing sensitive information like secret keys and passwords within version control systems (VCS) poses a significant challenge for developers. Keeping credentials secure while maintaining necessary access for development and production environments is paramount. This post explores various methods to secure your sensitive configurations, specifically tailored for use with Git and Django, ensuring that your secrets remain protected while staying version-controlled.
